551)༄༅/ /grags/skar ma rab rib/༈las kyi gaṇ+ḍi brdung nas/dge slong rnams nangadu bsdus/dge tshul rnams sgo khang du bkar/dge slong rnams kyi phyir bco

tei:div.tei:p: grags/ skar ma rab rib/ ༈ las kyi gaṇ+ḍi brdung nas/ dge slong rnams nangadu bsdus/ dge tshul rnams sgo khang du bkar/ dge slong rnams kyi phyir bcos dang byin brlab gso sbyong gi dus ji bzhin pa las/ byin brlab kyi skabs/ gso sbyong mdzad la zhes pa/ dgag dbye mdzad la/ zhes kha bsgyur ba'i khyad par ro// de nas dge tshul rnams dang bcas pa thams cad tshogs khang du rgyun ltar tshogs nas/ tshigs su bcad pa/ bstod pa bcas zin nas/ mdo bskul gy-i tshig phrad bsgyur tshul ni/ bstan pa rin po che'i/ deng dge 'du+un gyi dbyar snga ma zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dgag dbye bcu bzhi pa lags te/ gtsug lag khang gi bdag po sogs nas/ bklag tu gsol/ zhu/ de nas rgyun chags gsum pa/ gtor ma bsngo ba'i bar chad lhag med par mdzad nas/ dbyar bdag pas chos bskul gso sbyong bzhin zhu/ mkhan po khri la 'jogs te/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i tshab tu/ de yang sa ga'i lhas/ sdig pa dman gyi gso sbyong ni// dgag dbye byas nas yang mi bya// gso sbyong dag par bya phyir te// dgag dbye yang ni de nyid yin/ /zhes gsungs pas= gnyen po bslab pa sogs nas tshul khrims rnam dag gi mdo 'don/ ja) btang*/ chab len/ de'i rjes su dge tshul rnams kyis phyir bcos rkyang pa re bya/ gso sbyong mi dgos/ kun spyod gso sbyong gi skabs/ 552) ji lta ba bzhin byas/ de'i rjes su dge tshul rnams yol ba'i rgyab tu zhal gyen du phyogs pa'i thad gral gyis bzhugs/ gzhan thams cad kyang rang gral du 'khod/ dgag dbye dang 'dun pa len dgos pa yod na skabs 'dir/ gzhung bzhin 'bul/ 'bul tshul gso sbyong gi dus ltar bya/ de nas mkhan pos/ las thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba ltung thun byin gyis brlab pa la/ gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bgyi bar dge 'dun rnams spyod lam bstun nas gsol ba'i las la thugs gtad par zhu sogs kyis ltung mthun byin brlabs bya/

gso sbyong zhes pa la dge 'dun gyi dgag dbye bcu bzhi pa lags la zhes pa'i 'don pa bsgyur/ de nas dbyar bdag pa gnyis/ dgag dbye byed pa por bsko ba ni/ mkhan pos/ dge slong thub bstan/ zhes bgyi ba khyod gnyis dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye byed par spro'am/ de gnyis kyis kyang spro lags zhu/ mkhan pos/ khong dag spro bar gda' bas dgag dbye byed pa po bsko ba la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bgyi bas dge 'dun rnams spyod lam bstun nas/ thog mar gsol ba'i las la thugs gtad par zhu/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong xx xx zhes bgyi ba dag dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyi par spro na/ gal te dge 'dun gyis dus la bab cing bzod na/ dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang*/ dge 553) 'dun gyis dge slong xx xx zhes bgyi ba 'di dag dgag dbye byed par bskos te/ dge slong dgag dbye bgyid par xx xx zhes bgyi ba 'di dag dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyid par 'gyur ro// 'di ni gsol ba'o// brjod pa mjug sdud dang bcas pa la thugs gtad par zhu/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong xx xx zhes bgyi ba 'di dag dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyid par spro ste/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge slong xx xx zhes bgyi ba 'di dag dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyid par bsko na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong*/ xx xx zhes bgyi ba 'di dag dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyid par bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsungs shig gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang na/ dge 'dun gyis dge slong xx xx zhes bgyi ba dag dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyid par bskos lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsungs bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to// yang mkhan pos/ dgag dbye bya ba'i phyir dge 'dun thugs mthun pa gsol ba'i las la thugs gtad par zhu/

dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi dgag dbye bcu bzhi pa lags te/ gal te dge 'dun gyis 554)dus la bab cing bzod na/ dge 'dun gyis gnang ba mdzod cig dang*/ deng dge 'dun gyi dgag dbye mdzad do// 'di ni gsol ba'o// de ltar las rnams byed pa'i tshe 'gro 'dug spyod lam bstun dgos pas lag len ji lta ba ma 'khrul bar bya'o// de nas dbyar bdag rgan pas mkhan po nas bzung g.yas gral gnas brtan rnams dang*/ dbyar bdag gzhon pas g.yon gral dge slong gzhon pa rnams dang*/ gnyis kas dge tshul rnams dang bcas pa la rtswa rnams khyab par brim/ de nas mkhan po khri las bzhengs te gding ba'i khar bzhugs pa'i drung du/ gding ba ring brkyang bting ba'i khar phyag gsum 'tshal/ rkang lag 'dud rgya dang bcas/ bstan pa rin po che'i dgag dbye'i cho ga la thugs gtad par zhu/ mkhan pos/ chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin gnang bar zhu/ tsog pur 'dug pas yul rten gnyis kas rtsa rgya gram gyi bting pa zhabs kyis mnan la rtse mo thal mo'i bar du 'dzin pa dang*/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi dgag dbye bcu bzhi pa lags te/ bdag shākya'i dge slong xx xx zhes bgyi ba'i yang dgag dbye bcu bzhi pa lags na/ bdag shākya'i dge slong xx xx zhes bgyi ba bdag la mthong ba dang*/ thos pa dang*/ dogs pa'i gnas gsum gyis dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyid kyi/ tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyis bdag la gdam du gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyis 555) bdag la rjes su bstan du gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyis bdag la rjes su bzung du gsol/ thugs brtse ba can tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyis thugs brtse ba'i slad du bdag la thugs brtse bar mdzad du gsol/ ltung ba shes shing mthong na chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin slar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum/ thabs legs bya/ phyag gsum/ bstan pa rin po che'i/ dgag dbye'i cho ga la thugs gtad pa bka' drin che lags/

mkhan pos/ chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin gnang ba la rjes su yi rang*/ bka' drin che lags bslab thob ltar bya/ de nas mkhan po g.yas gral 'go'i gnas brtan gnyis dang bcas pas dbyar bdag rgan pa'i drung du dgag dbye de ltar mdzad pa sogs g.yas gral mthar chags dang*/ gzhon pa'i drung du gzhon gral mthar chags su gsum las mi mang bar dgag dbye mdzad do/ de bzhin du dge tshul rnams nas kyang mdzad nas kun rdzogs pa dang*/ dbyar bdag pa gnyis nas dge slong gi gral mjug nas yar bsdus te grangs bzung nas dbyar bdag rgan pas gral gsham nas gding ba brkyang bting khar phyag gsum sngon du 'gro bas 'greng ste 'dud rgya dang bcas te/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bkra shis pa'i gtsug lag khang thub bstan= xx xx gling 'di na/ dge slong bcu phrag bcu dang brgyad kyis dgag dbye mdzad do// zhes pa 556) lta bu grangs dang bstun te brdzod do/ dge 'dun rnams kyis/ legs par dgag dbye mdzad do// shin tu dgag dbye mdzad do// de nas dbyar bdag rgan pas phyag mi dgos par spyod lam de nyid kyis sngar blangs pa'i dar ram ras sam gang yin pa de lag g.yas pas 'phyar/ g.yon gyin bstan gyis 'dud pa dang bcas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun gyis rdzas 'di lta bu la yang dgag dbye ru ngam/ zhes dris pas/= lan du kun kyis/ legs par rung ngo*// shin tu rung ngo*// de nas dge tshul thams cad kyis rtswa rnams dbyar bdag pa gnyis kyis bsdus nas/ grangs bzung ste/ dbyar bdag pas gding ba bzhi bltab khar 'greng ste gzan shad bcas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bkra shis pa'i gtsug lag khang thub bstan xx xx gling 'di na dge tshul bcu phrag xx xx dgag dbye mdzad do// zhes pa lta bu brjod/ dge slong rnams dang bcas kun kyis/ legs par dgag dbye mdzad do// shin tu dgag dbye mdzad do//

zhes lan brjod/ dbyar bdag pa spyod lam de nyid kyis sngar bzhin/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun gyi rdzas 'di lta bu la yang dgag dbye rung ngam/ zhes brjod/ yang dge slong rnams dang kun kyis/ legs par rung ngo*// shin tu rung ngo*// zhes lan gdab/ de nas dbyar bdag pa gnyis dge tshul rnams dang bcas pa/ nang du 'ongs 557) nas gral du 'khod ma thag thug) pa btang*/ chab bkye bsdu zin nas/ mkhan pos/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad deng 'dir dgongs su gsol/ thal sbyar kun kyis/ dgongs su gsol zhes mthun 'gyur gnang*/ mkhan pos dal bus bskul te/ bsod nams 'di yis/= 'jam dpal dpa' bos = rin chen dge tshogs= gang du skyes pa'i= phan bde'i 'byung gnas= de ltar 'grub par byed pa'ang= byang 'dren pas bskul te/ rgyal ba kun kyi = nas snang grags= skar ma rab rib = kyis gung seng phebs/ dbyar mi gnas pa'i dge slong gzhan yod na'ang 'di nyin dgag dbye mdzad na gso sbyong go chod pas kun 'ong dgos so/ de ni dngos gzhi rnams so/ kun dga' ra bar phebs nas cha gsum btang*/ slar yang*/ mkhar rnga dang gaṇ+ḍis bskul te tshogs/ chab bzhes te nang du phebs nas ser sbrengs kyis rten gsum rnams rang gnas su gdan drangs zin nas slar nang du phebs te rang gral du sngar ltar 'khod/ de ma thag zhal ta pas dbyar rnyed rnams gral mthar bzhag/ yi ge klog la mkhan pos gtsos 'dus pa rnams la rtsis sprod zhu/ de nas dbyar bdag pa dang zhal ta pa dge tshul rnams kyis phyag bde mdzad nas so sor bsgos te 'dus pa kun yi rangs bar bya/ de nas dge 'dun 558) pa rnams kyis rang skal gzims shag tu bskyal/ dbyar bdag pas tshul shing rnams phyogs gcig tu dril nas ston pa'i tshul shing gi rtser cod pan du mkhan pos mdzad pa'i lo rtags dge slong dang dge tshul gyi zhal grangs shis brjod tshig rgyan gyis spud pa bris nas gtsug lag khang gi sgo steng du 'dogs par bya'o//

nyin gung sngar bzhin brdas bskul ste tshogs nas chab bzhes/ rang gral du 'khod pa dang*/ gung tshigs rgyun bzhin btang*/ bsngo yig zhu ba dang*/ ltung bshags smon lam res bab bcas rgyun ltar ro// spos la me sbar/ bla ma yi dam = sogs nas bkra shis zhal bskor rgyas par mdzad/ de nas bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam sogs kyus ltar bya'o// skabs 'dir/ ja) btang*/ chab bkye bsdu bya/ de nas bla gos gsol bzhin/ snam sbyar gtur bur bcug ste phrag tu bkal/ so so'i gding ba lag tu thogs nas/ gzan gal khyer byas nas mkhan pos mdun bsus dge skos kyis spos sna dang rgya gling bcas gtsug lag khang la g.yas bskor mdzad de tshogs grol ba ni rgyun ltar ro// de'i phyi dro nas/ dbyar bdag pa/ zhal ta pa dge tshul rnams kyis ljongs rgyu gang du mdzad pa'i gling khar/ gur dang sbra ther phub/ gsol thab 'dzin/ mchod pa gso sbyong gi skabs ltar legs par bsham/ bsang khri bca'/ bsang shing bsags/ gdan khri gral gdan sogs yid du 'ong ba bya'o// dmigs bsal rkyen dbang gis dgag dbye dgos na gzhung bzhin du mdzad/ 559) de rnams kyis dgag dbye ji ltar bya tshul rnams legs par bstan zin no/ ༈ de nas ljongs rgyu ji ltar phebs tshul ni/ de'i phyi nyin dge 'dun rnams rgyun ltar/ dung gi sgras legs par 'du bar byas te/ dung gsum pa rdzogs ma thag gtsug lag khang gi sgo khang du 'dzoms par mjad nas/ dge slong thams cad kyis/ bla gos/ snam sbyar dang bcas pa bzhes/ zhwa mnab/ mkhan pos phyag tu mkhar bsil bsnams/ thams cad kyis gzan zlum khyer gyis bslab gral ma 'chol bar legs par bsgrigs nas/ 'di skabs gtsug lag khang gi yang steng nas bsang btang*/ dung dmar dang*/ rgya gling 'bud/ gling khar yang bsang gtang dgos/ sngon du dge tshul gaṇ+ḍi pas gaṇ+ḍi thogs/ chab ril pa gnyis kyis chu bum dang bzed zhal bsnams/ de rjes dung gling*/

de rjes dge skos kyis spos bam me sbar ba lag tu thogs pas mdun bsus te ser sbrengs kyi phebs par bya'o// de yang ngag bcad pa dang*/ na bza' sogs legs par bgos/ ring blta mgo gtum sogs khyim 'gro'i spyod pa nyi shu spangs te gzhan dang ba 'dren par bya'o// gling khar nye ba dang*/ dge tshul gaṇ+ḍi pa dang*/ chab ril pa gnyis kyis zhwa phrag la bkal te sngon du song nas/ rung khang sgo nas gaṇ+ḍi rgyud gsum tog gsum brdung ba dang*/ rung chu byin brlab bya/ gaṇ+ḍi ci'i phyir zhes dris pa la/ dge 'dun bsdu ba'i 560) phyir ro// zhes lan gdab/ de nas rung khang gi byin brlab byas nas/ gzim gur du phebs pa'i tshe/ phyi rol du mchil lham phud/ chab bzhes/ rang gral du 'khod ma thag/ ja mchod dang ja)zhus dkyus ltar bya/ chab 'bul len bya/ skar ma rab rib kyis tshogs grol/ dga' spro'i tshul gyis lung rigs dang mthun pa'i bgro gleng rtsod ngag ltar gtang na legs/ gzhan du bag med kyi rtsed mo/ ngag 'khyal sogs 'dul ba dang mi mthun pa'i las rnams mi mdzad/ slar mkhar rnga dang*/ gaṇ+ḍis bskul te tshogs/ tshigs bcad res mos/ sdom rgyun gsol 'debs dang*/ rgyun chags gsum pa 'phrog gtor bsngo ba dang bcas grub ma thag rang gral du 'khod/ chu gtor brgya rtsa gdangs shar tsam btang*/ chab blangs te/ skar ma rab rib kyis tshogs grol/ slar brdas bskul te tshogs/ thub bstod/ gnas bcu/ byams smon gsungs/ dbyar bdag pas spos bskor dang bcas bya/ gsol thang zhu/ chab 'bul len byas rjes/ skar ma rab rib brjod nas tshogs grol/ gung seng mdzad/ slar brdas bskul te tshogs grub pa dang gung tshigs gnang/ kun kyis zhal phud bca' ba sogs tshul bzhin mdzad/ bdud bzlog zin ma thag tshogs grol/ gung seng gnang*/ slar brda bcas tshogs te/ gnam chos gtor bsngo/ bskang ba bcas dang*/ bzang spyod smon lam bkra shis dang bcas pa dkyus ltar mdzad/

gnas de nyid du bzhugs pa yin na chos 561) spyod kyi bya ba ma gtogs chos min gyi rigs gtan nas mi mdzad do// nyin dang po ji lta ba bzhin nyin gnyis pa dang gsum pa'ang 'dra la/ nyin gsum pa'i bkra shis rgyas pa btang grub nas de 'phror/ dge slong rnams chos gos rnam gsum dang*/ dge tshul rnams bla gos sogs gos tshag dang spyod lam legs par bsdam te/ gaṇ+ḍi pa/ chab ril pa gnyis/ dbyar bdag pa spos dang bcas sngon du 'gro bas/ mkhan pos thog drangs bslab gral ma 'chol bar zhwa mnab pa sogs sngar ji bzhin byas te tshur gtsug lag khang gi sgo khang nang bar phebs/ de nas snam sbyar bla gos rnams dril te gtur bur bcug ste rang gi gnas su phebs pa lags/ tshur phebs tu nye ba'i tshe yang*/ gtsug lag khang gi yang steng nas bsang btang zhing dung rgya gling 'bud/ gling kha nas kyang de bzhin du mdzad de/ yar mar res mos su bsnyen bkur bstab bo/ bslab pa yongs sbyong gzhi gsum gya/ི /cho ga thar gling bgrod pa'i gra/ུ /zin bris stobs ldan ded dpon des// thar 'dod srid mtsho las sgrol shog ces pa'am bla ma'i zhal lung ji lta ba bzhin shākya'i dge slong thub bstan chos kyi glang po phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes bris pa phyogs dus kun tu dge legs kyi snang ba chen pos khyab par gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ/ dge'o/// / 562)
